sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Chloe, Brian, Ursula take up arms and a day's rations (5,359 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ Chloe stared down the Big Beast and it backed off — 1 round, not a scratch on them. It breaks and runs — the treeline is clear of it. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Chloe faced The Eater at the treeline... and didn't come back. The party carries the body home. The sortie is over.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Eater gorges at the treeline — 1,750 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
